cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-1, [[Tactic]] cards level 0-1, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Blitzkrieg, Kaiserschlacht, Warrior's Pride, 1 random basic weakness. Bonus Experience: You begin the campaign with 5 additional experience (does not affect the number of weaknesses you must take in Standalone Mode).
cards.name: Thunder General Adelheid
cards.text:
[free]: Move 1 damage or horror from a player card at your location to another.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may move 1 damage from Thunder General Adelheid to Blitzkrieg.

cards.name: Toko
cards.text:
Rain Pou deck only.
You have 1 additional hand slot.
[free] Exhaust Toko: Choose an enemy up to 1 connection away. It loses the alert and retaliate keywords until the end of the round. If it is non-[[Elite]], it loses all keywords until the end of the round instead.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-3, cards that "succeed by" level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Seeker and/or Mystic ([seeker] and/or [mystic]) cards level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Sunflower Seeds, Limitless Appetite, Gluttony, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Cherna Mouse
cards.text:
Seeds on Sunflower Seeds are considered to be resources in your resource pool for the purposes of counting resources.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may move up to 3 seeds from Sunflower Seeds to your resource pool, as resources.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Abacus, Self Doubt, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Requirements: At deck creation, choose "even" or "odd." It is your "parity."
cards.name: Calkoro
cards.text:
[reaction] When you search your deck: Reveal 1 of the searched cards with a printed resource cost that matches your parity. Then, discover 1 clue at your location. If you cannot, gain 1 resource. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. Draw 1 card. If your skill value matches your parity, draw 1 card.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, [[Practiced]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Enchanting Drugs, Mage's Staff, Overdose, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Mana
cards.text:
You begin with Enchanting Drugs in play.
[reaction] When you would test your [willpower]: Test your [willpower] + another skill instead. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Ready Enchanting Drugs.

cards.name: Fu
cards.text:
Permanent. @NyanNyan deck only.
Uses (3 talismans). Limit 3 talismans on Fu.
[reaction] After you commit a non-attached card to a skill test, spend 1 talisman and exhaust Fu: Attach it facedown to Fu instead of discarding it (max 3 cards attached). Attached cards may be committed to skill tests as if they were in your hand.

cards.name: Social Awkwardness
cards.text: Revelation - Discard any number of cards from your play area and/or from your hand. For every 2 classes not among cards you discarded, take 1 horror.

cards.name: Dissociation
cards.text: Revelation - If you have not exiled any cards this game, take 1 horror and shuffle Dissociation into your deck. Otherwise, for each card you exiled this game, take 1 horror.

cards.name: Osk Vault
cards.text:
Permanent. Lethe deck only.
[reaction] After your turn begins: Choose a facedown card in your vault and reveal it.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, [[Creature]] cards level 0-5, [[Summon]] cards level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Enthralled, Voracious Dragon, Ravenous Beasts, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Nonako Miyokata
cards.text:
[reaction] When a non-unique [[Creature]] or [[Summon]] ally you own enters play: Attach the top card of your deck facedown to it, as a familiar. (It is an exact copy of attached card and does not take up any slots.) (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may play an [[Ally]] asset from your discard pile, reducing its cost by 2.

cards.name: Starfall
cards.text: Dreamy Chelsea deck only. Seal ([bless]). [free] Exhaust Starfall: Seal 1 [bless] token here. [action] Release 1-10 [bless] tokens sealed here: Fight. ([willpower]) You get +1 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for each [bless] token released as part of this ability's cost.

cards.name: Overdose
cards.text: Revelation - Put Overdose into play in your threat area. Forced - After you commit 1 or more cards to a skill test, take 1 damage. [action] Discard cards from your hand with a total of 5 or more icons: Discard Overdose.

cards.name: Gaslighting
cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. While Gaslighting is in your hand, you cannot activate abilities on scenario cards (except for the ability below) or cancel encounter card effects. [action][action][action]: Discard Gaslighting.

cards.name: Enthralled
cards.text:
Permanent. Nonako Miyokata deck only.
[reaction] When a non-unique [[Creature]] or [[Summon]] ally enters play under your control, exhaust Enthralled: Attach the top card of your deck facedown to it, as a familiar. (It is an exact copy of attached card and does not take up any slots.)

cards.name: Blackmail
cards.text: Hidden. Peril. Revelation - Secretly add Blackmail to your hand. You cannot play [[Ally]] assets. [action] Remove 2 [[Ally]] assets in your discard pile from the game: Discard Blackmail.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Prism Mirror, Mediocrity, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Prism Cherry
cards.text:
You begin with Prism Mirror in play.
[reaction] When you reduce the shroud value of a location: That location gets -1 shroud for the duration of that effect.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Your location gets -1 shroud until the end of your turn.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, [[Fortune]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Lady Luck's Contract, Karmic Balance, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Premium Sachiko
cards.text:
[reaction] When a player card effect would cause you to discard cards from hand, lose resources, lose actions, take damage, or take horror: Perform the opposite of that aspect instead. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may treat this as any other token in the chaos bag instead, ignoring its effects.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, [[Charm]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Bonded Gemstones, Mermaid's Tear, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Lapis Lazuline
cards.text:
Your arcane slots can be used to hold cards that take up accessory slots.
You get +1 [willpower] for each [[Charm]] asset you control.
You get +1 [combat] for every 2 [[Charm]] assets you control.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may play a [[Charm]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 1.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 1-4. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Glimpse Beyond, 3 copies of Cognitive Overload, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Old Blue
cards.text:
[reaction] When you look at 1 or more cards from any investigator's deck: Look at 2 additional cards. You may place any of the looked at cards on the top or bottom of their deck, in any order.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Look at the top card of any investigator's deck.

cards.name: Holy Blessing
cards.text:
Sister Nana deck only. Fast.
Play Holy Blessing under the control of an investigator at your location.
While Sister Nana is at your location, you may trigger [free] abilities on [[Talent]] assets she controls as if it were under your control. (Both investigators may pay its cost.)

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-3, up to 10 other Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Starfall, Clumsy, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Dreamy Chelsea
cards.text:
[reaction] After an asset you control is discarded by a player card effect: Add 3 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may discard an asset you control to automatically succeed instead.

cards.name: Magical Watergun
cards.text: Pshuke Prains deck only. Seal (3 [bless]/[curse]). [action] If there are tokens sealed here: Fight ([combat]). When you reveal chaos tokens for this test, resolve a token sealed here instead. If the resolved token is a... - [bless] token, this attack deals +1 damage. - [curse] token, this attack deals +2 damage.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Warden's Thread, Aimless, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Filru
cards.text:
[reaction] When you spend 1 or more resources: Place 1 of them on your location, as a thread. (Limit once per phase.)
[reaction] When an enemy enters a location with a thread: Take it as a resource and exhaust that enemy.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may take up to 3 threads on any location as a resource.

cards.name: Frenzied Demon
cards.text: Prey - Lady Proud only. Hunter. While Frenzied Demon has damage on it, it gets -2 fight.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose Guardian ([guardian]), Seeker ([seeker]), or Survivor ([survivor]). Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, [[Item]] assets of your chosen secondary class level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. cards.name: Micchan the Dictionary
cards.text:
[reaction] After you resolve an [[Item]] [action] ability, name an icon on it: Resolve an [action] ability on a different [[Item]] asset you control with a matching icon, ignoring its [action] cost. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may swap an [[Item]] asset you control with a different [[Item]] asset with a matching icon from your hand.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, [[Spirit]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Pirate Ship Drop, Never Back Down, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Captain Grace
cards.text:
[reaction] When you commit a [[Spirit]] card to a skill test you are performing: You get +1 skill value for this test. Shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it. Then, draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Until the end of the round, ignore the limit on the above [reaction] ability.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, [[Bold]] cards level 0-3, [[Fated]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Passionate Love, Compassionate Love, Longing, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Love Me Ren-Ren
cards.text:
[reaction] When you play or commit a [[Bold]] or [[Fated]] card: Either increase each number in its text box by 1 or shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may return a [[Bold]] or [[Fated]] card from your discard pile to your hand.

cards.name: Compassionate Love
cards.text:
Love Me Ren-Ren deck only.
Fast. Play when you would play an event.
While resolving its effects, the played event gains the [[Fated]] trait and "If it is your turn, end your turn. Shuffle this card into your deck instead of discarding it."

cards.name: Mounted Cannon
cards.text: Cannon Catherine deck only. [action] Place 1 of your clues on your location and exhaust Mounted Cannon: Fight ([combat]). You get +X [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack, where X is the shroud value of your location.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, [[Science]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Blooming, Wilting, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Setup: After the game begins, search your bonded cards for a random [[Flora]] asset and put it into play.
cards.name: Marika Fukuroi
cards.text:
[reaction] After your turn begins: Play a [[Science]] card from your hand, reducing its cost by 1.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Heal 1 damage from a card you control.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose 2 classes ([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], or [survivor]). Deckbuilding Options: Cards with the customizable keyword level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards from your chosen classes level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Reconstruct, Self Preservation, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Rareko
cards.text:
[reaction] After a phase begins, choose an upgrade sheet for a customizable card you own: Until the end of the round, treat one of its upgrades as if each of its checkboxes are filled, ignoring the 10 checkbox limit. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each upgrade sheet you control.

cards.name: Bewitched
cards.text: Bonded (Ame-no-Habakiri). Attached enemy loses its printed prey keyword and gains "Prey -- Lethe only." If it is non-[[Elite]], it loses patrol and gains hunter. When Bewitched would leave play, instead set it aside, out of play (with your bonded cards).

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 3 copies of Weighted Blow, Nemesis, 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Criminal]] cards.
cards.name: Masked Wonder
cards.text: [action]: Fight ([agility]). This attack can only target exhausted enemies. [reaction] After you damage an exhausted non-[[Elite]] enemy: Either move it to a connecting location or it does not ready during the next upkeep phase. [elder_sign] effect: +1. You may deal 1 damage to an exhausted enemy at your location.

cards.name: Storm of Blades
cards.text:
Ripple deck only.
[reaction] After you discard Storm of Blades from your hand: Play it.
Deal 1 damage to each enemy at your location. Shuffle Storm of Blades into your deck.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, cards with "uses (supplies)" level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Item]] assets that "discard" level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Scrap, Powered Kumi-Kumi Fortress Mode, Analysis Paralysis, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Kumi-Kumi
cards.text:
[free] During your turn, discard a non-weakness [[Item]] asset from your hand or play area: Place 1 supply on Scrap. If that asset was in your play area, place 2 additional supplies on Scrap. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Place 1 supply on an asset you control.

cards.name: Solar Haven
cards.text:
Bonded (Blooming).
Solar Haven enters play with 1 damage on it. 
[free] If there is no damage here: Until the end of the round, each enemy at your location gets -1 fight, -1 health, and -1 evade. Set Solar Haven aside, out of play (with your bonded cards).

cards.name: Crystal Ball
cards.text:
Pythie Frederica deck only.
[action]: Choose a revealed non-empty location. Either move to that location or take an action as if you were there.
[reaction] When you would move, exhaust Crystal Ball: Move a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location instead.

cards.name: Material Communion
cards.text: Detec Bell deck only. Your location gains "Haunted -- Gain 1 resource or draw 1 card." while you are there. [action] Exhaust Material Communion: Parley. Investigate. If you succeed, you may look at the revealed side of a connecting unrevealed location.

cards.name: Memory Candy
cards.text:
Permanent. Bluebell Candy deck only.
Uses (5 candies).
Once per round, you may play a level 0-5 event in the discard pile of an investigator at your location. After that event resolves, exile it. As an additional cost to initiate this ability, spend 1 candy and exhaust Memory Candy.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, [[Ritual]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Material Communion, Pareidolia, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Detec Bell
cards.text:
[reaction] After your turn begins, choose a location or a treachery attached to it: Treat its printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]) until the end of the round.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may look at the other side of any scenario card in play.

cards.name: Model Student
cards.text: Revelation - Put Model Student into play in your threat area. Forced - When you would fail a skill test: Take 1 horror. [action] Place 2 of your clues on your location: Discard Model Student.

cards.name: Analysis Paralysis
cards.text: Revelation - Discard 3 cards at random from your hand. For each [[Item]] asset that did not enter your discard pile by this effect, lose 1 action.

cards.name: Express Delivery
cards.text:
Postarie deck only.
Choose a card in the discard pile of any investigator and return it to their hand.

cards.name: Crimson Skeleton
cards.text: Aloof. Spawn - Any connecting location. Forced - When Magical Daisy reveals a [bless] token: She must either treat it as a [curse] token instead or take 1 horror.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, [[Blessed]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Palette, Crimson Skeleton, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Magical Daisy
cards.text:
[reaction] After you reveal a [bless] token, choose one effect you have not yet chosen this round:
- Gain 1 resource.
- Draw 1 card.
- If this is during a fight ability, this attack deals +1 damage.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may treat this token as if it were a [bless] token. Do not reveal additional tokens.

cards.name: Tempest
cards.text: Princess Tempest deck only. Uses (4 charges). [reaction] After an enemy engages you, spend 1 charge and exhaust Tempest: Evade ([agility]). If you succeed, you may move to a connecting location.

cards.name: Job Security
cards.text: Revelation - Take 2 horror and remove each card beneath Preservation from the game. If no cards were removed from the game by this effect, shuffle Job Security into your deck.

cards.name: Till Death Do Us Part
cards.text:
Weddin deck only.
Fast. Play when you would succeed at a skill test.
Add Till Death Do Us Part to the victory display and seal a non-[auto_fail] token revealed during this skill test on it.

cards.name: Lady Luck's Contract
cards.text:
Premium Sachiko deck only.
[reaction] When you would reveal a token, exhaust Lady Luck's Contract: Search the chaos bag for a token with an equal or lower modifier and reveal it instead. Add 1 [curse] to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Abrasiveness
cards.text: While Abrasiveness is not in your deck or discard pile, icons on assets committed to skill tests you perform subtract from your skill value instead of adding to it. Forced - When Abrasiveness is discarded during a skill test: Take 1 damage. Then, return it to your hand. [action]: Discard Abrasiveness.

cards.name: Reinforcement
cards.text:
Calamity Mary deck only.
Fast. Play only during your turn and if you control a [[Firearm]] asset.
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Upgrade]] event, attach it and Reinforcement to a [[Firearm]] asset you control, and shuffle your deck.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose Guardian ([guardian]), Mystic ([mystic]), or Rogue ([rogue]). Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 level 0-1 events and/or skills of your chosen secondary class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Reinforcements, Rout, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: CQ Angel Hamuel
cards.text:
[reaction] When an [[Ally]] asset you control is discarded (except when it is defeated): Resolve a [reaction] ability on it as if it entered play. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may return an [[Ally]] asset you control to your hand.

cards.name: Magical Umbrella
cards.text:
Umbrain deck only.
You may play cards beneath Umbrain as if they were in your hand. Remove that card from the game instead of discarding it.
[reaction] When an enemy attacks an investigator at your location, exhaust Magical Umbrella: Cancel that attack.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 25. Deckbuilding Options: Multi-class cards level 0-5, [[Synergy]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class. cards.name: Kana
cards.text:
Your neutral cards count as a "neutral" class.
[reaction] When you play a card: Reduce its cost by 1 for each non-permanent card you control of the same class as the played card. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Draw 1 card for every 2 classes among cards you control.

cards.name: Nevermore
cards.text: Revelation - Take 1 horror. If you have... - ...5 or more cards in your deck, take 1 additional horror. - ...10 or more cards in your deck, take 1 additional horror. - ...20 or more cards in your deck, take 1 additional horror.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-3, up to 10 other Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Thread the Needle, Inferiority Complex, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Classical Lillian
cards.text:
[reaction] When you would succeed at a skill test: You succeed by 1 less. Then, place 1 thread on Thread the Needle. (Limit twice per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may take any number of threads on Thread the Needle, as resources.

cards.name: Lost Child
cards.text: Forced - When Lost Child leaves play except by the [action] ability below: Princess Quake suffer 1 mental trauma. Add Lost Child to the victory display. Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Lost Child before it can be assigned to your investigator card. [action]: You guide the child to safety. Discard Lost Child.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-1, cards that "move you" level 0-1, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Speed Demon, Too Close to the Sun, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.name: Princess Tempest
cards.text: [reaction] When you move (except by an encounter card effect), disengage from each enemy engaged with you. Gain 1 resource for each enemy disengaged this way. (Limit once per phase.) [elder_sign] effect: +1. You may move to a connecting location.

cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. cards.text:
Love Me Ren-Ren deck only.
Fast. Play when you would play an event during your first action.

cards.text:
Kuru-kuru Hime deck only.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose an investigator at your location to immediately take an action as if it were their turn. For each skill test performed during that action, the chosen investigator gets +2 skill value.

cards.text:
Swim Swim deck only. Uses (0 secrets).
[reaction] After you cancel or ignore the effects of a symbol, exhaust Royal Ambition: Place 1 secret on it.
[reaction] When a non-[auto_fail] symbol is revealed at your location, spend 3 secrets: Use the following effect instead of that symbol's normal effects -- "+0. If you succeed, draw 1 card."

cards.text:

[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may choose and discard a non-weakness treachery from play.

cards.name: Blazing Gerbera
cards.text:

Blazing Gerbera enters play with 1 damage on it. 
[free] If there is no damage here: Discover 1 clue at your location. Until the end of the round, your location gets -1 shroud. Set Blazing Gerbera aside, out of play (with your bonded cards).

cards.name: Reactive Armor
cards.text: Permanent. Armor Arlie deck only. [reaction] When you place X damage and/or horror among [[Item]] assets you control, exhaust Reactive Armor: Fight ([combat]). You get +X [combat] for this attack. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals X damage.

cards.name: Carbon Copy
cards.text: Revelation - Put Carbon Copy into play in your threat area. Forced - When you draw an encounter card: Carbon Copy is an exact copy of that card.

cards.text: Swarming 1. Prey - Princess Deluge only. Shufflin's swarm cards cannot attack. Forced - When Shufflin is defeated: Princess Deluge draws it. If it is Shufflin (Ace of Spades), it attacks her.

cards.text:

One at a time, investigators at your location, as a group, may play up to X [[Ally]] assets in total from their hands, reducing the resource cost of each by 2. Each investigator who plays an [[Ally]] asset as part of this effect draws 1 card.

cards.name: Mini Tepsekemei
cards.text:
Tepsekemei deck only.
Mini Tepsekemei enters play at your location. It can be assigned damage and horror dealt to any investigator at its location. You may take fight and evade actions as if your were at its location and engaged with each enemy there.
[reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Mini Tepsekemei: Move it to the evaded enemy's location.

cards.name: Glimpse Beyond
cards.text:

cards.name: Snow White
cards.text:
Engage actions you perform do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[reaction] After you take an engage action or become engaged with an enemy as a result of a player card effect: Take a fight action. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may engage an enemy at your location.

cards.name: Never Back Down
cards.text: Revelation - Put Never Back Down into play in your threat area. it. Forced - When you commit a card to a skill test you are performing: You get -2 skill value for each non-matching icon on the committed card. If you fail, take 1 horror and shuffle Never Back Down into your deck.

cards.name: Armor Arlie
cards.text:
Each of your [[Armor]] assets contributes its skill icons to all tests you perform (not counting [wild] icons).
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may add an [[Armor]] asset from your discard pile to your hand.

cards.flavor: "I'll get the truth out, no matter what."
cards.name: Whistleblower
cards.text: Aloof. Furthest location from all investigators. Pfle's clues cannot be spent. Pfle cannot draw cards. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: If Whistleblower is engaged, disengage it.

cards.name: Rain Pou
cards.text:
[reaction] When you trigger a fight ability on a [[Firearm]] asset: This attack may target a non-[[Elite]] enemy up to one location away from its standard range, ignoring the aloof and retaliate keywords. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If this is an attack, you may choose any enemy in play; this attack targets the chosen enemy instead.

cards.name: Mage's Staff
cards.text: Mana deck only. [free]: Attach a non-weakness skill from your hand to Mage's Staff. Limit 1 skill attached. [action] Exhaust Mage's Staff: Investigate/Fight/Evade ([willpower]). Commit the attached skill, if able. Do not discard it when the test ends.

cards.name: Recollection
cards.text:
Permanent. Kana deck only.
For each non-permanent...
- ...[guardian] card you control: You get +1 [combat].
- ...[seeker] card you control: You get +1 [intellect].
- ...[mystic] card you control: You get +1 [willpower].
- ...[rogue] card you control: You get +1 [agility].
- ...[survivor] card you control: You get +1 health and +1 sanity.

cards.name: Baddest Gun in the West
cards.text: Revelation - Put Baddest Gun in the West into play in your threat area. Forced - When you attack an enemy: Set your base skill value to 2 for this attack. If this attack defeats an enemy, discard Baddest Gun in the West.

cards.name: Laid to Rest
cards.text: Revelation - Put Laid to Rest into play in your threat area. You cannot trigger [reaction] abilities on cards you control. [action]: Place 1 death on Resurrection. Discard Laid to Rest.

cards.name: Weighted Blow
cards.text:
Masked Wonder deck only.
Commit only to a skill test during an attack or evasion attempt against an enemy. If this skill test succeeds, either automatically evade the targeted enemy or deal 1 damage to it.

cards.name: Finale
cards.text:
Stanczyka deck only.
Commit only to a test you are performing, and only if it is your turn.
If you succeed, you get +3 skill value during the first skill test you perform next turn. After this test ends, end your turn.

cards.name: Stuffed Rabbit
cards.text:
Hardgore Alice deck only.
You get +1 health and +1 sanity.
[reaction] When you assign damage and/or horror that would defeat you, discard Stuffed Rabbit: Cancel up to 4 of that damage and/or horror.

cards.name: Audacious
cards.text: Revelation - Put Audacious into play in your threat area. Forced - When you draw a treachery card: Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each resource on Audacious (from the token bank). If you succeed, place 1 resource here. Otherwise, take 1 horror and shuffle Audacious into your deck.

cards.name: Toolkit
cards.text:
Shadow Gale deck only. Uses (4 supplies). If there are no supplies here, discard it.
[free] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Toolkit: Choose an [[Upgrade]] card in play that you own or your discard pile and return it to your hand. Then, gain 1 resource.

cards.name: Pulling the Strings
cards.text:
Rionetta deck only.
[reaction] When an [[Ally]] asset you control would be discarded by Rionetta's forced ability, exhaust Pulling the Strings: Exhaust it instead. You may take a basic fight or investigate action, adding its health or sanity value respectively to your skill value for that action.

cards.name: Thesaurus
cards.text:
Micchan the Dictionary deck only. 
Uses (5 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Thesaurus: Name a non-[wild] icon. Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a card with a matching icon and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

cards.text:
You get 1 additional arcane slot for each unique token sealed on cards you control.
[reaction] After a player card effect seals a token on a card you control: Gain 2 resources. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Gain 1 resource for each unique token sealed on cards you control.

cards.name: Space Suit
cards.text:
Genopsyko Yumenoshima deck only.
Until the end of the phase, you get +1 to each of your skills for each non-weakness encounter card you have drawn this phase.
[reaction] After you cancel a revelation effect or attack, exhaust Space Suit: Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Self Doubt
cards.text: Revelation - If the number of cards in your hand matches your parity, take 2 damage. Otherwise, take 2 horror. Discard each card in your hand with a printed resource cost that matches your parity.

cards.name: Dark Cutie
cards.text: Forced - After your turn begins: Until the start of your next turn, you get a total of +X to your skills divided as evenly as possible, where X is the shroud value of your location. [elder_sign] effect: +1. Increase X by 2 while resolving the above forced effect during your next turn.

cards.name: Magical Glasses
cards.text: Glassiane deck only. [action] Exhaust Magical Glasses: Investigate. Investigate any revealed location in play as if you were at that location. You may use the shroud value of your location for this investigation.

cards.name: Blooming
cards.text: Permanent. Marika Fukuroi deck only. Damage on your [[Flora]] assets can be healed as if it were on you. Forced - When the [[Flora]] asset you control would leave play: Instead, search your bonded cards for a set aside [[Flora]] asset and swap them.

cards.name: Canary Wheelchair
cards.text: Pfle deck only. [action] Exhaust Canary Wheelchair: Fight ([combat]). You attack with a base [combat] skill of 4. This attack deals +1 damage. [action] Exhaust Canary Wheelchair: Evade ([agility]). You evade with a base [agility] skill of 4. If you succeed, you may move to a connecting location.

cards.name: Sweet Nothings
cards.text:
Mephis Pheles deck only. Uses (1 whisper).
Sweet Nothings cannot be played using a play action.
Treat each icon on assets committed to skill tests you perform as [wild].
[free] Spend 1 whisper: Commit an asset you control to this test.
